items.title: The Club Schedule That Used Old Data

A.question: What is the main lesson of the passage?
A.answer: Past records are useful only when the conditions behind them are checked against the present situation.
A.evidence: Past records were useful, but only after the club checked whether the conditions behind them were still true.
A.evidenceJp: 過去の記録は役立ちましたが、その背景の条件が今も同じか確かめて初めて使える情報だったのです。
A.reason: The final sentence states the lesson from relying too heavily on last year's attendance.

A.question: Why did Tuesday stop being the best day for full-group practice?
A.answer: A new school activity had been introduced on Tuesdays this year, so several members could no longer attend.
A.evidence: Soon several members said they could not attend because the school had introduced a new Tuesday activity this year.
A.evidenceJp: ところが今年は学校で新しい火曜活動が始まり、何人かが参加できないと言いました。
A.reason: The new condition made last year's Tuesday attendance pattern outdated.

A.question: Which statement is true according to the passage?
A.answer: After checking everyone's current weekly commitments, the club found Thursday was the only day nearly all members were free.
A.evidence: The club collected everyone's weekly commitments and found Thursday was now the only day nearly all members were free.
A.evidenceJp: 全員の一週間の予定を集めると、ほぼ全員が空いているのは木曜日だけでした。
A.reason: The current schedule data directly supported moving the main practice.

A.question: Why was asking students simply to adjust their own plans a weak first response?
A.answer: The conflict came from a school-wide change in Tuesday conditions, not just from individual poor planning.
A.evidence: Soon several members said they could not attend because the school had introduced a new Tuesday activity this year. The leaders first asked those students to adjust their plans.
A.evidenceJp: ところが今年は学校で新しい火曜活動が始まり、何人かが参加できないと言いました。部のリーダーは最初、その生徒たちに予定を調整するよう求めました。
A.reason: The schedule conflict was structural, so current group-level data was more appropriate than blaming individuals.

A.question: Which day became the main full-group practice day?
A.evidence: They moved the main practice and used Tuesday for small groups.
A.evidenceJp: そこで中心の練習を木曜へ移し、火曜は少人数練習にしました。
A.reason: The translation and preceding sentence identify Thursday as the new common day.

B.question: In “the conditions behind them,” what does “them” refer to?
B.evidence: Past records were useful, but only after the club checked whether the conditions behind them were still true.
B.evidenceJp: 過去の記録は役立ちましたが、その背景の条件が今も同じか確かめて初めて使える情報だったのです。
B.reason: The pronoun points back to the past records in the same sentence.

B.question: Complete the summary: Last year's attendance suggested Tuesday, but current schedules showed that ____ was now the best common day.
B.evidence: The club collected everyone's weekly commitments and found Thursday was now the only day nearly all members were free.
B.evidenceJp: 全員の一週間の予定を集めると、ほぼ全員が空いているのは木曜日だけでした。
B.reason: The current commitments replaced the outdated assumption based on last year's data.

B.question: Complete the idea: The club used Tuesday for ____ after moving the main practice.
B.evidence: They moved the main practice and used Tuesday for small groups.
B.evidenceJp: そこで中心の練習を木曜へ移し、火曜は少人数練習にしました。
B.reason: Tuesday remained useful, but for a different kind of practice.

B.question: Where would this sentence fit best: “The old data was accurate about last year, but the schedule conditions had changed.”
B.answer: After the sentence explaining that the school introduced a new Tuesday activity this year.
B.evidence: Soon several members said they could not attend because the school had introduced a new Tuesday activity this year. The leaders first asked those students to adjust their plans.
B.evidenceJp: ところが今年は学校で新しい火曜活動が始まり、何人かが参加できないと言いました。部のリーダーは最初、その生徒たちに予定を調整するよう求めました。
B.reason: The inserted sentence clarifies why last year's successful Tuesday pattern no longer predicted current attendance.

B.question: What should the club do before using last year's attendance to plan next year?
B.answer: Check whether school activities and members' schedules are still similar to the conditions that produced the old pattern.
B.evidence: Past records were useful, but only after the club checked whether the conditions behind them were still true.
B.evidenceJp: 過去の記録は役立ちましたが、その背景の条件が今も同じか確かめて初めて使える情報だったのです。
B.reason: The conclusion explicitly requires checking whether background conditions still hold.
